pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' stance; standing on hind legs with the neck held straight up.
pose_constraints.orientation: 0-degree dead-on frontal view. The sail is centered and rises vertically behind the neck.
pose_constraints.camera_angle: Low-angle 'Hero' shot, looking up to maximize the visual height of the dorsal sail.
pose_constraints.body_logic: Torso and tail are hidden behind the chest. Forelimbs are held close to the body. Silhouette width max 260px.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The sail should have a smooth, arched top edge that creates the highest point of the silhouette.

character_details.expression: Friendly and calm; large, warm eyes with a soft spec-glint.
character_details.texture: Clean, tactile skin with subtle 'wrinkle' details around the joints. Color: Pale teal with a sun-burnt orange and yellow sunburst pattern on the sail.
features: High dorsal sail supported by long neural spines.
Small thumb spikes on the hands.

environmental_details.ground: Soft, sun-bleached river sand with small patches of succulent-like plants.
flora: Broad-leafed ferns and simplified 'play-set' conifers in the distant background.
environmental_details.sky: Bright, high-noon blue sky to provide a high-contrast background for the colorful sail.
environmental_details.lighting: High-key 'Sunny Exposed' lighting with a warm glow through the thin skin of the sail (subsurface scattering effect).
